ORF1A.note: ball python nidovirus ORF1a 17,412 nt / 5,803 aa (Stenglein 2014); the subfamily spans 3,840 aa (shingleback nidovirus) to 6,570 aa (veiled chameleon serpentovirus B)

S.note: BPNV ORF2 S, 959 aa; subfamily range 821-1,141 aa

M.note: BPNV ORF4 M, 215 aa, three N-terminal TMs, 21% identity over 116 aa to white bream virus M

N.note: BPNV ORF5a N, 152 aa, Arteri_nucleo Pfam hit, pI 10.6; divergent genera reach 129-246 aa and are bound to this protein by homology, never by length
